rows.item_description: Creating a work group to make recommendations concerning bridge collisions by large commercial vessels. (Remote Testimony Available).
Establishing a department of transportation map for the placement of campaign signage. (Remote Testimony Available).
Modernizing the adopt-a-highway program to improve its ability to meet its original purpose within existing fiscal limitations. (Hearing is on the Proposed Substitute.) (Remote Testimony Available).
Requesting the transportation commission to designate a section of Interstate 82 as the Washington state patrol trooper Charles Frank Noble, Jr. memorial highway. (Remote Testimony Available).
Designating the State Route Number 3 overpass at the junction of Chico Way NW in Bremerton as the Joe Mentor memorial overpass. (Remote Testimony Available).
Concerning payments to tow truck operators for the release of vehicles to indigent citizens. (Remote Testimony Available).
Creating additional requirements for collector vehicle and horseless carriage license plates to improve compliance and public safety.
Addressing the current backlog of vehicle inspections.
Developing best practices for responding to electric vehicle fires.
Ensuring connectivity for Washington wildlife through safe passages.
Promoting the better understanding of certain federal standards related to commercial driver's licenses.
Changing the vessel length requirement in obtaining nonresident vessel permits.
